meta.name: ore-gens
meta.author: MohamedGonem
meta.description:
Blocks that extract and synthesize ore from airborne trace elements,
dissolved ion suspensions and cryogenic precipitation - plus a fully
self-contained liquid economy.

Five tiers per ore:
- Small Powered (2x2): fast, needs power, moderate cost.
- Small Unpowered (2x2): slow, no power, expensive to build.
- Liquid-fed (3x3): fast, needs water (ozone on Erekir), no power.
- Cryofluid-fed (3x3): fastest, needs power + cryofluid.
- Magma-fed (4x4): ultimate output, needs slag (gallium on Erekir) + cryofluid + power.

Ores: copper, lead, coal, titanium, scrap, thorium, sand (Serpulo),
beryllium, tungsten (Erekir).

Self-contained liquids: water/ozone, cryofluid and slag/gallium generators
produce every liquid the tiers consume, each progressively more expensive.

Multi-ore synthesizers (4x4) batch-produce basic ores with fixed ratios;
refined and advanced versions add titanium and thorium.

Every tier is gated behind a 3-step research quest (15 milestones per ore).
Upgrades run to ten levels each - Speed I-X, Capacity I-X, Output I-X,
Efficiency I-X - with escalating, huge research costs.
Animated: powered, liquid, cryo and magma tiers glow and spin while running.
